instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are built using modular React (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements, buttons, forms, and cards.
Use backdrop-blur-xl glassmorphism for floating components with border-cyan-500/20 strokes.
Implement the 7 core services with distinct manifesto chapter numbers (01 to 07).
Integrate the consultation submission endpoint /api/consultations for storing lead data.
Add responsive WhatsApp quick action triggers with number 085171114889.
Provide a realistic interactive AI Legal Chatbot simulation pre-populated with Indonesian business permit knowledge.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts; use bold asymmetric grid structures with generous spacing.
Layer elements with subtle ambient cyan glow drop-shadows and glass border strokes.
DO NOT use raw transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or modals - always use backdrop-blur and semi-opaque dark surface.
Ensure high text contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1) for legibility against dark backgrounds.
